categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: Ethylene Glycol (EG) business, Gas business, and Specialty Chemicals business. It manufactures and sells products such as ethylene glycol, ethylene oxide, industrial gases (oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide), ethanolamines, ethylene glycol ethers, carbonate esters, and epoxy derivatives. The company also engages in investment businesses and other related chemical manufacturing activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes high-efficiency catalyst operations for ethylene oxide and ethylene glycol production, advanced continuous high-pressure reaction equipment for polyether amines and ethyleneamines, and proprietary technologies for CO2 capture and utilization. It employs environmentally friendly processes such as non-phosgene methods for carbonate ester production and develops high-purity and customized chemical products. The company also integrates green chemistry and circular economy principles in its manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream industries such as polyester fiber, PET bottle manufacturers, electronics and semiconductor sectors, pharmaceutical, steel, metal processing, textile, construction, and agricultural chemical industries. Major markets served are Taiwan, China, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Africa, Europe, and the Americas. The company supplies industrial gases to semiconductor and electronics industries and specialty chemicals to various industrial and consumer product manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan and China, with production facilities in Kaohsiung (Taiwan) and Yangzhou (China). It serves domestic markets and exports to Southeast Asia, North America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America. The company also has investment holdings in Bermuda and British Virgin Islands for global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream in the chemical supply chain, producing key chemical intermediates such as ethylene oxide, ethylene glycol, and specialty chemicals. It also supplies industrial gases and downstream chemical derivatives, positioning itself as a manufacturer and supplier to various downstream industries including textiles, electronics, and construction materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing green, electronic, and new material product lines centered on ethylene oxide. R&D focuses on high-value-added specialty chemicals, CO2 capture and utilization technologies, biodegradable materials, recycled plastic surfactants, and lithium battery electrolyte components. The company invests in advanced catalyst and polymerization technologies, electronic chemical products, and sustainable manufacturing processes aligned with carbon neutrality goals by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of chemical intermediates, industrial gases, and specialty chemicals. The company also earns income from investment holdings. Sales contracts with major customers and long-term supply agreements form the basis of revenue, supplemented by customized product development and technical service offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds significant market share in Taiwan for ethylene glycol (~30%), ethanolamines (~60%), and ethylene glycol ethers (~70%). It competes with major international chemical producers such as Nippon Shokubai, Optimal-Petronas, Thai Ethanolamines, Sabic, and Sadara in specialty chemicals. The company leverages proprietary technology, product quality, and green chemistry to differentiate itself amid global overcapacity and price competition, especially from Chinese producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$23.8 billion, a 14% increase from the previous year. Net loss after tax was NT$164 million, improved from prior losses. Total assets were about NT$31.4 billion with equity attributable to owners around NT$10.8 billion. The company invests significantly in R&D (~NT$229 million in 2024) and capital expenditures (~NT$1.9 billion planned for 2025) to support growth and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes green and sustainable chemical production, including CO2 capture and utilization, environmentally friendly manufacturing processes, and development of high-purity, high-value specialty chemicals. It offers integrated supply chain solutions with stable raw material sourcing and technical service capabilities. Differentiation is achieved through proprietary technologies, product customization, and focus on emerging markets such as electronics, lithium batteries, and environmentally conscious applications.
